sloka: नेयमर्हति चैश्वर्यं रावणान्तःपुरे शुभा ।अनन्या हि मया सीता भास्करेण प्रभा यथा ।। ६.१२१.२० ।।
transliteration: neyamarhati caiśvaryaṁ rāvaṇāntaḥpure śubhā ।ananyā hi mayā sītā bhāskareṇa prabhā yathā ।। 6.121.20 ।।

translations.english: "Mythili is unsullied in the three worlds. Renouncing her is not feasible just as fame and as she is like my own self."
